profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Atlassian leading technical strategy for high-growth monetization teams. I recently delivered +$8M in incremental ARR and directed a critical migration of 5,000+ data tables for 300+ global engineers. I specialize in building resilient, high-scale systems that bridge the gap between complex engineering and strategic product growth.

Beyond shipping code, I focus on engineering velocity and operational excellence. I’ve revitalized development protocols to save 840+ hours/month for engineering teams and cut PR cycle times by 5 hours through new build-health protocols.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Leadership & Strategic Direction
• Delivered 16+ high-impact experiments, notably spearheading experiments that delivered +$8M in incremental ARR via multi-edition upgrades and low-friction onboarding funnels
• Directed a high-stakes migration of 5,000+ data tables for 300+ global engineers, unblocking core infrastructure upgrades on a critical 1-week deadline
• Architected cross-functional experiments for 12 stakeholders across zero-overlap timezones (IST, AEST, PST, EST), ensuring delivery across complex billing architectures
• Optimized roadmap execution by identifying platform constraints and engineering scalable solutions that saved 14+ weeks of effort and unblocked 8+ concurrent experiments

Data-Driven Experimentation & Growth
• Drove product strategy by independently generating and validating experiment ideas using quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize high-value initiatives
• Optimized data infrastructure, reducing pre-analysis runtimes by 4 hours per run and building automated observability dashboards to monitor experiment health
• Ensured data integrity and experiment viability by auditing cross-functional data streams, identifying  APIs bugs, and resolving audience clashes between overlapping experiments

Mentorship & Influence
• Mentored 5+ junior to mid-level engineers on technical strategy and experiment leadership, enabling them to take on high-visibility stretch goals
• Increased team velocity by revitalizing retrospectives and implementing build-health escalation protocols for persistent infrastructure issues
• Scaled engineering onboarding by authoring self-service documentation and troubleshooting guides, reducing initial setup time for new engineers by ~1 day per project

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Shipped a winning Confluence Home Page experiment during a 2-month secondment; engineered SSR solutions and implemented strategic technical workarounds to bypass API performance bottlenecks; authored onboarding guide and standardized patterns to halve setup time for 12+ engineers

positions.title: Scrum Master
positions.description:
• Led an Agile development team of 5 engineers in scrum by facilitating biweekly sprints & retrospectives, pruning issues, resolving blocks, and generating sprint delivery metrics, saving 14+ man-hours/sprint
• Devised a new Jira issue management workflow in collaboration with the project manager and wrote Groovy scripts to automate issue linking and creation, which shortened the QA cycle by 4+ hours/week

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed 55+ modules as the primary engineer across 3 Angular and Express.js projects, constructing complex components, intuitive user interfaces, clean controllers, and custom middleware
• Increased developer velocity by 20% by re-architecting Angular and Express.js codebases and designing components with a single responsibility, consolidating duplicated code, creating reusable forms, separating smart from presentational components, and managing global application state reactively
• Optimized the UX in the account management Portal (30+ modules) by lazily loading modules to cut down on load times, reducing unnecessary component re-renders, and implementing pre-navigation checks to prevent displaying inaccessible components
• Achieved 99.95% availability on a customer callback service implemented in NodeJS on AWS Lambda (35K+ requests/day) by establishing testing procedures, producing comprehensive test suites to validate outbound callback content and the transpiled call control language, and maintaining 85% code coverage
• Initiated the push for higher code quality across 6 JavaScript/TypeScript projects (1,600 files) by adding unit tests to untested codebases and refactoring bloated components and functions, which reduced QA time by 15% and accelerated new engineer onboarding
• Implemented a data-layer microservice for the Programmable Messaging product in Java, exposing an internal REST API to CRUD delivery statuses and message histories in an Apache Cassandra cluster
• Co-designed Cassandra database schemas for the SMS product, utilizing materialized views to improve read times by 30% and fine-tuning keyspace and query settings for eventual consistency and availability
• Contributed to the development of new methods in the Programmable Voice and Messaging REST API (20M requests/month) by writing JavaScript policies in Apigee to integrate with internal APIs
Built CI/CD pipelines using TravisCI to securely generate, test, and publish C# and Java client SDKs

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Contributed to alpha versions of messaging and interactive calls APIs in Java, using company’s internal APIs
•	Designed MySQL schemas for the mass messaging API, utilizing foreign key relationships, cascading deletes, and stored procedures

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Participated as a core member of a web scraping automation project designed to streamline the company's internal software development process by writing several modules to automatically scrape content from Linux vendors' security announcements and store it in a SQL Server database
•	Independently developed a data scrubbing application that was responsible for reporting incorrect data in the company's primary database for generating their security checks using regexes, machine learning
